title_zh: 让篮球训练减少对单一得分手的依赖

scenario.label_zh: 调整篮球队的传球与防守练习
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清依赖单个队员的问题并约定练习轮转和传球

context_zh: 一支虚构美国业余篮球队讨论进攻配合和防守轮转，采用美式拼写。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Our defense fell apart whenever Jordan came off the court.

sentences.speaker: Coach Reed
sentences.text: He's our dominant player, but the rest of the team needs to communicate without him.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: He also seems to dominate every practice game. The others just pass to him and stop moving.

sentences.speaker: Coach Reed
sentences.text: Then we need a more dynamic practice, with everyone cutting into space and making decisions.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Could we start with a passing game where everyone has to touch the ball before a shot?

sentences.speaker: Coach Reed
sentences.text: Yes, then switch to a drill on defensive rotations. Jordan can join the second group rather than lead the first.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: I'll explain the two drills and make sure everyone gets a turn.

targets.sense_zh: 占主导地位的；影响最大的
在比赛或活动中占据支配地位
充满活力并不断变化的
